about.subtitle: About
about.title: Video Production
about.bio1: I've been editing and producing videos since 2023, helping various companies. I also work on individual projects, whether for myself or for brands, companies, and individuals.
about.bio2: I'm a professional video producer with experience in titling, masking, grading, scene setup, and professional production. I'm not a question, I'm the solution.
about.bio3: Always open to learning new things.
about.bio4: Video production and editing is my hobby and job. I love it and I'm here to make you visible on social media. Professional since 2023.
about.bioText: I love visual creation. Every project is an opportunity to create something that captures attention and leaves an impression.
